sandbox: macOS sandbox-exec: no network, home folder unreadable, one scratch folder writable

tools.name: parse_date_string
tools.description:
Parse a string representation of a date and time into a datetime object using various supported formats.
    
    Args:
        timestr: A string containing a date/time stamp.
        ignoretz: If set True, time zones in parsed strings are ignored and a naive datetime object is returned.
        
    Returns:
        A string representation of the parsed datetime object in ISO format.
        
    Example:
        >>> parse_date_string("2023-10-15 14:30:00")
        '2023-10-15T14:30:00'
